message.content:
Wool coat in charcoal gray (#3e4448), relaxed fit cut with a straight hemline reaching mid-thigh, deep navy blue hex #1b263b fabric that resists wind and light snow.

Shearling-lined leather boots in black (#000000), chunky lug sole for grip on salted icy roads, knee-high shaft length, soft nubuck upper texture.

Silk scarf in silver-gray gradient (#c0c5ce), lightweight drape cut, rectangular shape with frayed edges, brushed cotton blend fabric to absorb moisture from the cold air.

This outfit works because the charcoal wool coat provides essential thermal insulation against the -15°C freezing temperatures while the structured silhouette maintains a professional work-appropriate look. The black shearling boots are crucial for safety and warmth on salted snowy roads, with their raised soles preventing slips during your walk to work. A silver scarf ties the cool color palette together without adding bulk, reflecting light in the winter environment while keeping the neckline cozy against the cold wind.
